Daily images & winners

Pick a day, change the window photo if needed, upload the MTD Performance and Compete & See screenshots, add the winner on reveal days, then press Download updated page and upload the file to GitHub. M = MTD added, C = Compete & See added, 🏆 = winner added, ☆ = winner missing.

How to publish the update on GitHub
  1. Press Download updated page. Your browser saves a file called index.html. If it's called index (1).html, rename it index.html.
  2. Open the repository on github.com and click Add file → Upload files.
  3. Drop index.html in and click Commit changes. It replaces the old file.
  4. Wait one or two minutes, then reload the advent link to check the update.

Login tracking

A GitHub page can't store anything by itself, so logins are sent to a Google Sheet you own. Each login adds a row: Email, Access, Day, Month, Year, Time. Download the sheet as Excel whenever you need it (File → Download → Microsoft Excel).

Open the login sheet
Set up the Google Sheet (once, about 10 minutes)
  1. In Google Drive, create a new Google Sheet (for example "Advent logins").
  2. In the sheet, open Extensions → Apps Script. Delete what's there, paste the script below and click Save.
  3. Click Deploy → New deployment, choose Web app. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Anyone, then Deploy and allow the permissions.
  4. Copy the Web app URL (it ends in /exec) into "Tracking web app address" above, and the sheet's own link into "Login sheet link".
  5. Press Send a test login: a row marked "test" appears in the sheet.
  6. Press Download updated page and upload it to GitHub. From then on every login adds a row.
// Compete & See Advent Calendar – login tracker
// Paste in the Google Sheet: Extensions > Apps Script, then Deploy > Web app.
function doPost(e) {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.tryLock(10000);
  try {
    var d = JSON.parse((e && e.postData && e.postData.contents) || '{}');
    var email = String(d.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9._%+'-]+@tiffany\.com$/.test(email)) {
      return ContentService.createTextOutput('ignored');
    }
    var access = ['public', 'back office', 'test'].indexOf(d.access) >= 0 ? d.access : 'public';
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName('Logins') || ss.insertSheet('Logins');
    if (sh.getLastRow() === 0) {
      sh.appendRow(['Email', 'Access', 'Day', 'Month', 'Year', 'Time (Milan)']);
      sh.setFrozenRows(1);
    }
    var now = new Date(), tz = 'Europe/Rome';
    sh.appendRow([
      email,
      access,
      Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'd')),
      Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'MMMM'),
      Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'yyyy')),
      Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'HH:mm:ss')
    ]);
    return ContentService.createTextOutput('ok');
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

The sheet will hold colleagues' email addresses, so check with IT / data protection that a Google Sheet is OK for this.

Passwords

Change a password, then download the page and upload it to GitHub. The new one works from then on and the old one stops working.

The rules

  • One winner per cluster on each reveal date: the highest month-to-date score.
  • You can win only once. If the leader has already won, the prize goes to the next advisor in the ranking.
  • The Grand Finale on 31 December is open to everyone, including earlier winners.
  • Every client advisor is eligible. Ties are broken by Sales vs target %, then AUR, then transactions.
  • Targets for transactions, AUR and sales shares depend on your store.
Scores are validated by Retail Performance the morning after.
